# Register lazy notification and QR elements without eagerly importing their bodies

1037 replaces side-effect imports of in-app-notification and qr-code-wizard with defineLazyCustomElement calls. The owned consumers still create or use those tags when needed; registration does not import the element module up front. Current notification uses a moz-src module URI while QR retains a chrome URI. Keep the actual tag/module pair and current URI rather than copying an old package URI blindly. This is a specific consumer transition, not a recommendation to make every element lazy.

Scope: Notification and QR lazy custom-element consumers.
